title: Markus wiki
description:
Wiki pages render in two stages: Jinja templates first against the live issue index, then anthus-markus (Anthus-Flavored Markdown) for semantic HTML. The console styles Markus classes and does not invent a second markdown dialect.

## Definition of Done
- Acceptance specs for Jinja then Markus are on develop
- Python wiki render uses Jinja then markusmd.convert
- Console preview consumes backend HTML and styles Markus classes
- One PR against develop
